description: Stage A explicit allow-list: start from --disable-everything, enable only what MP3/FLAC open/probe/metadata/artwork/decode/seek/EOF needs. Library boundary: libavformat + libavcodec + libavutil + libswresample.

demuxer:mp3.reason: only demuxer that can open MPEG audio container/ID3/xing

demuxer:flac.reason: only demuxer for native FLAC (STREAMINFO/VorbisComment/PICTURE blocks)

decoder:mp3float.reason: mp3float is the decoder a full FFmpeg build resolves for AV_CODEC_ID_MP3 (registered before the fixed-point mp3 alias in codec_list); enabling it keeps PCM identical across N0..N3. The fixed-point alias ff_mp3_decoder is NOT enabled.

decoder:flac.reason: only FLAC decoder in Stage A corpus

parser:mpegaudio.reason: candidate: needed for mp3 framing/stream-info. Necessity is decided by the removal probe (bench/provenance), not assumed.

lib:swresample.reason: format conversion + planar->interleaved. Separately probed by profile n3-min-noswr.
